title: Resolution setting 16% late tax interest rate for high-value properties
summary: This resolution sets the interest rate for late payment of property taxes at 16% per year for Fiscal Year 2027, applying to properties assessed above $450,000 or co-ops valued above $450,000 per unit. The rate keeps the current level unchanged from Fiscal Year 2025, despite the Banking Commission recommending 18%. The Council cites declining delinquency rates as justification for maintaining the lower rate.
